response.answer: A workable option is a remote offsite only after you have had recovery time and, if relevant, received therapist clearance. Avoid a standing, long in-person retreat immediately after overnight flood monitoring: you reported unreliable attention after such monitoring and that prolonged standing can quickly aggravate your Achilles flare. A brief, low-demand remote format with flexibility to step away would better fit those limits.
